lines.en: Amir, look at the river. Last year it was full of rubbish.
lines.pt: Amir, olha o rio. No ano passado ele estava cheio de lixo.

lines.en: I remember. Bottles and bags were thrown into the water.
lines.pt: Eu me lembro. Garrafas e sacolas eram jogadas na água.

lines.en: Then a big clean-up was organised by the city.
lines.pt: Aí uma grande limpeza foi organizada pela prefeitura.

lines.en: Yes, and many volunteers were invited. Over a hundred people came.
lines.pt: Sim, e muitos voluntários foram convidados. Mais de cem pessoas vieram.

lines.en: A lot of rubbish was collected in one morning. Even an old bicycle was found.
lines.pt: Muito lixo foi recolhido numa manhã. Até uma bicicleta velha foi encontrada.

lines.en: Really? Where was it found? In the mud near the bridge?
lines.pt: Sério? Onde ela foi encontrada? Na lama perto da ponte?

lines.en: Yes. It was pulled out of the water by three students.
lines.pt: Sim. Ela foi tirada da água por três estudantes.

lines.en: The bags were put into the bins, and the glass was taken to a recycling centre.
lines.pt: As sacolas foram postas nas lixeiras, e o vidro foi levado a um centro de reciclagem.

lines.en: The bank of the river was cleaned, too. Now ducks swim here again.
lines.pt: A margem do rio também foi limpa. Agora os patos nadam aqui de novo.

lines.en: It was a great day. The photos were shared by the city on the news.
lines.pt: Foi um ótimo dia. As fotos foram compartilhadas pela prefeitura no jornal.

lines.en: Let’s help again next spring. Maybe a new bike will be found!
lines.pt: Vamos ajudar de novo na próxima primavera. Quem sabe uma bicicleta nova será encontrada!

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “o lixo foi recolhido” com ser + particípio.
compare.us: Em inglês, use was/were + particípio: The rubbish was collected. Use was com singular e were com plural. Com by, você diz quem fez.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: The rubbish was collected.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio: The rubbish was collected. Use by + agente quando importa: It was found by three students.

facts.label: foi/foram + particípio
facts.sub: O passivo no passado se forma com was ou were + particípio: The rubbish was collected. Use was para singular e were para plural. O foco é a coisa, não quem fez.

facts.label: Por + agente
facts.sub: Use by + pessoa para dizer quem fez: The bike was found by three students. Se não importa quem fez, ou não se sabe, omita o by: The river was cleaned.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The passive past is was/were + past participle.
The rubbish was collected means someone collected it.
items.why: Yes, but we do not say who.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The passive past is was/were + past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes: was collected.)
The rubbish was collected means someone collected it. → Verdadeiro (Yes, but we do not say who.)
We say “The bottles was thrown.” → Falso (Bottles is plural: were thrown.)

pages.title: A river in Edinburgh · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Sunday in Edinburgh. Theo and Flo walk along the river. The water is clear and calm today. Some ducks swim near the bank. A year ago the same place looked very different. Flo wants to tell Theo a story.
“Theo, look at the river. Last year it was full of rubbish.” says Flo. “I remember. Bottles and bags were thrown into the water.” says Theo. “Then a big clean-up was organised by the city.” says Flo.
